speaker: Patient
text: The patient appears comfortable, with no signs of distress or discomfort noted by the parents. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical presentation of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead of an infant, particularly with a family history of psoriasis, is classic for seborrheic dermatitis (cradle cap). The lack of distress and characteristic appearance makes early-onset psoriasis less likely without more widespread involvement. DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic dermatitis
